Container.Name: immich-machine-learning
Container.Overview: Immich Machine Learning service. Handles face recognition, CLIP-based image search, and OCR. This service runs ML models locally. Models are downloaded on first use and cached. The default cache can grow to several GB depending on enabled features. For GPU acceleration, change the image tag to: release-cuda, release-rocm, release-openvino, release-armnn, or release-rknn. Must be on the same Docker network as the Immich server.
Container.Requires: This template uses your CPU for machine learning. For hardware accelerated ML, use one of the template that fits your (i)GPU. Must be on the same Docker network as the immich-server container. The server connects to this service on port 3003 by container name. Full setup guide: https://rorar.github.io/immich-unraid-manual/

Config.Name: Path: Model Cache
Config.Description: ML model cache directory. Models are downloaded on first use (several GB).

Config.Name: --- Advanced ---
Config.Description: Advanced ML settings. Defaults work well for most setups.

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL_TTL
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity before unloading models from memory. Set to 0 to keep loaded permanently.

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKERS
Config.Description: Number of ML worker processes. Increase if you have enough RAM/VRAM.

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKER_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds before a worker is considered unresponsive (use 300 for GPU).

Config.Name: IMMICH_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: verbose, debug, log, warn, error
